title: The AI agent map: what each one can do without asking you
excerpt: I measured nine AI agents as they come installed. The Observatory map shows how much each one can do without asking you, and why.
seo_title: AI agent map: what each one does without asking
seo_description: Nine AI agents measured as they come, on one Windows machine: their class from A to D, their six axes and their factory score. And what the map doesn't say.
